functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The surface app page must provide access to 100% of the customer system functionality as defined in the system specifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the surface app page to offer all customer system functionality, ensuring that no required features are missing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The surface app page must clearly indicate the available customer system functionalities through intuitive icons and labels, ensuring that 95% of users can identify the correct function within 5 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that the app page should be user-friendly, making it easy for customers to recognize and access the required features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The surface app page must support keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility, ensuring that 95% of users can navigate and use the page without a mouse or visual assistance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves providing access to all customer system functionalities, which should be accessible to all users, including those with disabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The surface app page must be available 99.9% of the time, with no more than 43.2 minutes of downtime per year.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to customer system functionalities, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The surface app page must ensure that all customer data displayed is accurate and up-to-date, with no more than a 1% error rate in data integrity.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying customer system functionalities, which rely on accurate and reliable data.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must display the correct information and settings related to the user's input, with a 0% error rate for valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to accurately display information and settings based on user input, ensuring that the information is correct.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must display the required information and settings within 500 milliseconds after receiving user input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time interaction with the system, requiring quick and responsive display of information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise instructions or tooltips for any settings that are not self-explanatory, ensuring that 90% of users can understand and use the settings correctly after a single attempt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying settings based on user input, which should be easy for users to understand and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must prevent users from entering invalid settings by providing real-time validation and error messages, with a 99% success rate in preventing invalid input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which should be validated to prevent errors and ensure the system's stability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all sensitive user settings and information using AES-256 encryption when stored and transmitted.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying user settings, which may include sensitive information that needs to be protected.
